definitions: A group of rock-forming tectosilicate minerals that make up about 60% of the Earth's crust. They crystallise from magma and lava in igneous rocks and are also present in many metamorphic and sedimentary rocks.
examples: The granite contained large crystals of feldspar.
Feldspar is a common mineral in many types of rock.
The weathering of feldspar contributes to soil formation.
